title: Perforated appendicitis on piperacillin-tazobactam alone after source control

clinical_review.notes: Owner approved revision 2 of the M6 library-growth draft (with OpenEvidence's review).

story: A 33-year-old woman had a laparoscopic appendectomy for perforated appendicitis with localized peritonitis. Source control is adequate; she is on piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 g IV every 6 hours alone and improving on postoperative day 1.

results.text: Leukocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

reference_answer: No intervention: a single agent with anaerobic activity; plan about 4 days of antibiotics after source control.
rationale: Negative control for the double-anaerobic-coverage rule: one agent that covers anaerobes must not trigger it.

citations.supports: Single agents with anaerobic activity for complicated intra-abdominal infection.
Current SIS guideline, including duration after source control; its text is not yet read (see its citation note).
Prospective audit and feedback of antibiotic therapy as a stewardship intervention.
